tasks.prompt: Hvað er að gerast á myndinni? Skrifaðu minnst 5 setningar.
tasks.promptTranslation: What is happening in the picture? Write at least 5 sentences.
tasks.imageDescription: A family scene in a kitchen: a man is cooking at the stove, a woman is sitting at the table reading a newspaper, a young boy is setting plates on the table, and a cat is sleeping on the floor near the door. Through the window, it is snowing outside. The kitchen has a modern Icelandic look with white cabinets.

taskCompletion.description: Does the response describe the picture content? Does it have at least 5 sentences? Does it cover multiple elements of the scene?

vocabulary.description: A2-appropriate vocabulary: kitchen items, family members, daily activities, weather. Uses varied words rather than repeating the same ones.

grammar.description: Basic Icelandic sentence structure. Subject-verb agreement. Correct use of present tense for describing what's happening. Basic noun cases (nominative and accusative).

coherence.description: Sentences relate to each other and build a description. Some logical flow (e.g., describing the scene from person to person, or from one part of the room to another).

tasks.sampleAnswer: Á myndinni er fjölskylda í eldhúsi. Maður er að elda mat á eldavélinni. Kona situr við borðið og les dagblað. Lítill drengur er að leggja diska á borðið. Köttur sefur á gólfinu við dyrnar. Úti er að snjóa og maður sér snjóinn í glugganum.

tasks.prompt: Einn dagur í lífi mínu. Skrifaðu minnst 5 setningar.
tasks.promptTranslation: One day in my life. Write at least 5 sentences.

taskCompletion.description: Does the response describe a typical day? Does it have at least 5 sentences? Does it cover different parts of the day (morning, afternoon, evening)?

vocabulary.description: A2-appropriate vocabulary: daily routine words, time expressions, food, work/school, leisure activities.

grammar.description: Basic sentence structure. Uses present tense appropriately. Time expressions (klukkan, á morgnana, á kvöldin). Basic connectors (og, en, svo, þá).

coherence.description: Chronological description of a day. Sentences connect logically. Uses time markers to create flow.

tasks.sampleAnswer: Ég vakna klukkan sjö á morgnana. Ég borða morgunmat með fjölskyldunni minni. Svo fer ég í vinnuna klukkan hálfníu. Ég vinn í verslun og hætti klukkan fimm. Á kvöldin elda ég kvöldmat og horfi á sjónvarpið. Ég fer að sofa klukkan ellefu.
